breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained a conflict between specifying `time_integration: Explicit forward Euler` and the more detailed `method: Strang splitting`. The ground truth resolved this by entirely removing the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' line. The agent failed to do this. Instead, it attempted to merge the two by stating, `Use explicit forward Euler time integration in the context of Strang operator splitting.` This is an incorrect description of the method and fails to remove the conflicting information, thus repeating the user's error.
